Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and higher education sector|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a global health crisis that causes millions of deaths every year and is projected to become the leading cause of death by 2050 unless preventive action is taken. Bone infections, in particular osteomyelitis (OM) and implant-associated infections, significantly increase this burden, especially with multidrug-resistant pathogens, which complicate treatment. Antibiotic-based treatment of bone infections is often ineffective due to biofilming, side effects and increasing bacterial resistance. Therefore, the RESCUE project aims to develop innovative injectable nanocomposite hydrogels with antimicrobial and osteogenic properties without the use of antibiotics. The main project activities include: 2. Research involving at least one of the following research categories: fundamental research, industrial research, experimental development. 3. Acquisition, validation and protection of technology rights (intangible assets). 4. Dissemination of knowledge generated by the project in the form of training, publications or transfer of know-how and technology. 5. Measures to ensure communication and visual identity requirements. Classification of projects according to the General Classification of Economic Activities: NACE:72.19 - Other research and experimental development in natural sciences and engineering. RESCUE's interdisciplinary R&D approach, which combines cutting-edge engineering innovations with cutting-edge medical biotechnologies, mainly corresponds to FORD code 2: Engineering and technology (including 2.5 Material engineering, 2.6 Medical engineering and 2.9 Industrial biotechnology) and FORD code 3: Medical and health sciences (in particular 3.4 Medical biotechnology). The main area of the RESCUE Research and Innovation Strategy for Smart Specialisation (RIS3) is Biomedicine, Medical Technologies and Biotechnologies. In addition, RESCUE supports the RIS3 area "Smart materials, technologies and engineering systems", thus contributing to the overall development of the Latvian economy. Focusing on the biomedical and pharmaceutical sectors, RESCUE strengthens Latvia's innovation capacity by contributing to the RIS3 goal of creating knowledge-intensive products with high added value. The project strengthens Latvia's innovation ecosystem by promoting cooperation between academic, research and industrial sectors, which is in line with the RIS3 objective of integrating Latvia into global value chains. In addition, RESCUE supports the RIS3 domain 'Smart materials, technologies and engineering systems' by creating multifunctional hydrogels from renewable natural resources, directly addressing the RIS3 focus on high-value bio- and composite materials for economic transformation. By developing smart biomaterials for regenerative medicine and antimicrobial applications, RESCUE supports Latvia's position in the field of biomedical innovation, promoting its export potential in solving critical health care issues. By promoting innovation in biomedicine, medical technologies and smart materials, RESCUE directly supports all three strands of the RIS3 transformation, transforming traditional industries, fostering future high-value-added growth sectors and ensuring horizontal economic impact through interdisciplinary collaboration and sustainable solutions. RESCUE results will contribute to economic sector growth and innovation according to NACE Rev. 2 - 32.50: Manufacture of medical and dental instruments and supplies, ensuring significant progress in this sector. At the start of the RESCUE project, the Technology Readiness Level (TRL) is defined as TRL 2, but TRL 5 is expected to be reached by the end of the project. In order to achieve the transition from TRL 2 to TRL 5, Project Action 2 is structured in 9 sub-actions focused on R&D. Under the RESCUE project, industrial research (sub-actions d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6, d7) will focus on the development and optimisation of injectable nanocomposite hydrogels. These hydrogels will be characterised in vitro under laboratory conditions to assess their antimicrobial, osteogenic, biocompatible and antioxidative properties by increasing the TRL from TRL 2 to TRL 4. Based on these in vitro results, the most effective composition of the nanocomposite hydrogel will be determined through experimental development (project subactions d8, d9) and tested in vivo in animal models. This assessment will confirm the biosafety and efficacy of the hydrogel for medical applications, allowing the project to achieve TRL 5. RESCUE is a non-economic cooperation project that combines multidisciplinary and cross-sectoral knowledge. Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Antimikrobiālā rezistence (AMR) ir globāla veselības krīze, kas katru gadu izraisa miljoniem nāves gadījumu, un tiek prognozēts, ka līdz 2050. gadam tā kļūs par galveno nāves cēloni, ja netiks veikti preventīvi pasākumi. Kaulu infekcijas, jo īpaši osteomielīts (OM) un ar implantiem saistītās infekcijas, būtiski palielina šo slogu, jo īpaši ar multirezistentiem patogēniem, kas sarežģī ārstēšanu. Uz antibiotikām balstīta kaulu infekciju ārstēšana bieži ir neefektīva biofilmu veidošanās, blakusparādību un pieaugošās baktēriju rezistences dēļ. Tāpēc RESCUE projekta mērķis ir izstrādāt inovatīvus injicējamus nanokompozītu hidrogēlus ar antimikrobiālām un osteogēnām īpašībām bez antibiotiku lietošanas. Galvenās projekta aktivitātes ietver: 2. Pētniecība, kas ietver vismaz vienu no šādām pētniecības kategorijām: fundamentālie pētījumi, rūpnieciskie pētījumi, eksperimentālā izstrāde. 3. Tehnoloģiju tiesību (nemateriālo aktīvu) iegāde, apstiprināšana un aizsardzība. 4. Projekta ietvaros radīto zināšanu izplatīšana apmācību, publikāciju vai zinātības un tehnoloģiju nodošanas veidā. 5. Komunikācijas un vizuālās identitātes prasību nodrošināšanas pasākumi. Projektu klasifikācija saskaņā ar Vispārējo ekonomiskās darbības klasifikāciju: NACE:72.19 - Citi pētījumi un eksperimentālā izstrāde dabaszinātnēs un inženierzinātnēs. RESCUE starpdisciplinārā pētniecības un attīstības pieeja, kas apvieno progresīvas inženierijas inovācijas ar modernākajām medicīnas biotehnoloģijām, galvenokārt atbilst FORD kodam 2: Inženierzinātnes un tehnoloģijas (ieskaitot 2.5 Materiālu inženierija, 2.6 Medicīniskā inženierija un 2.9 Rūpnieciskā biotehnoloģija) un FORD kodam 3: Medicīnas un veselības zinātnes (īpaši 3.4 Medicīniskā biotehnoloģija). RESCUE pētniecības un inovāciju stratēģijas viedās specializācijas (RIS3) galvenā joma ir "Biomedicīna, medicīnas tehnoloģijas un biotehnoloģijas". Turklāt RESCUE atbalsta RIS3 jomu "Viedie materiāli, tehnoloģijas un inženiersistēmas", tādējādi veicinot kopējo Latvijas ekonomikas attīstību. Koncentrējoties uz biomedicīnas un farmācijas nozarēm, RESCUE stiprina Latvijas inovācijas kapacitāti, veicinot RIS3 mērķa sasniegšanu - radīt zināšanu ietilpīgus produktus ar augstu pievienoto vērtību. Projekts stiprina Latvijas inovāciju ekosistēmu, veicinot sadarbību starp akadēmisko, pētniecības un rūpniecības nozarēm, kas atbilst RIS3 mērķim integrēt Latviju globālajās vērtību ķēdēs. Turklāt RESCUE atbalsta RIS3 jomu "Viedie materiāli, tehnoloģijas un inženiersistēmas", no atjaunojamiem dabas resursiem radot daudzfunkcionālus hidrogēlus, tieši pievēršoties RIS3 uzsvaram uz augstvērtīgiem biomateriāliem un kompozītmateriāliem ekonomikas transformācijai. Attīstot viedos biomateriālus reģeneratīvajai medicīnai un pretmikrobu lietojumiem, RESCUE atbalsta Latvijas pozīcijas biomedicīnas inovāciju jomā, veicinot tās eksporta potenciālu kritisku veselības aprūpes jautājumu risināšanā. Veicinot inovācijas biomedicīnā, medicīnas tehnoloģijās un viedajos materiālos, RESCUE tieši atbalsta visus trīs RIS3 transformācijas virzienus, pārveidojot tradicionālās nozares, veicinot nākotnes augstas pievienotās vērtības izaugsmes sektorus un nodrošinot horizontālu ekonomisko ietekmi, izmantojot starpdisciplināru sadarbību un ilgtspējīgus risinājumus. RESCUE rezultāti veicinās ekonomiskā sektora izaugsmi un inovāciju saskaņā ar NACE Rev. 2 - 32.50: Medicīnisko un zobārstniecības instrumentu un piederumu ražošana, nodrošinot nozīmīgu progresu šajā nozarē. RESCUE projekta sākumā tehnoloģiju gatavības līmenis (TRL) ir noteikts kā TRL 2, bet līdz projekta beigām paredzēts sasniegt TRL 5. Lai panāktu pāreju no TRL 2 uz TRL 5, projekta darbība Nr. 2 ir strukturēta 9 apakšdarbībās, kas vērstas uz pētniecību un izstrādi. Šos hidrogēlus laboratorijas apstākļos raksturos in vitro, lai novērtētu to antimikrobiālās, osteogēnās, biosaderīgās un antioksidatīvās īpašības, paaugstinot TRL no TRL 2 līdz TRL 4. Pamatojoties uz šiem in vitro rezultātiem, eksperimentālās izstrādes ceļā (projekta apakšdarbības Nr. d8., d9.) tiks noteikts visefektīvākais nanokompozītu hidrogēla sastāvs, kas tiks pārbaudīts in vivo dzīvnieku modeļos. Operation_Name_English: Development and improvement of the public space of the municipality at the house "Purenes", Zlēkas civil parish, Ventspils municipality

Category_Label: Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project ‘Development and improvement of the municipal public space at the ‘Purenes’ house in Zlēkas civil parish, Ventspils municipality’ (‘the project’) is to develop and improve the municipal public space at the ‘Purenes’ house in Zlēkas civil parish, Ventspils municipality (cadastral designations No 98940050079, No 98940050098, No 98940050099, No 98940050096). Within the framework of the project, it is planned to rebuild the existing public outdoor infrastructure with improvement, improving the quality of the living environment and increasing public safety. In accordance with the Kurzeme Planning Region Development Programme for the period 2021-2027[1], the Zlēkas parish of Ventspils municipality forms part of the functional area of both Ventspils city and Kuldīga city. Within the framework of the project ‘Development and improvement of the municipal public space next to the house “Purenes”, Zlēku civil parish, Ventspils municipality’ (‘the project’), the following activities will be carried out: improvement of the municipal public space (construction works) amounting to 7 428 m2, the object will be subject to author’s supervision, construction supervision and regular publicity measures within the framework of the project. The total cost of the project is planned to be EUR 418 621.59 (ERDF funding EUR 355 828.35, municipal funding EUR 62 793.24). The project is planned to be implemented within 24 months from the third quarter of 2024 to the third quarter of 2026. [1] Kurzeme Planning Region Development Programme 2021-2027

Ventspils novada pašvaldības Zlēku pagasts saskaņā ar Kurzemes plānošanas reģiona attīstības programmu 2021.-2027.gadam[1] iekļaujas gan Ventspils valstspilsētas, gan Kuldīgas pilsētas funkcionālās teritorijas zonā. Operation_Name_English: Support for the participation of Latvia in international research and innovation programmes

Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project ‘Supporting Latvia’s participation in international research and innovation programmes’ is to promote participation in research and innovation projects through international cooperation, to promote Latvia’s integration into the Common European Research Area (ERA), to link up with the development of the specialisation areas of the Latvian Smart Specialisation Strategy (RIS3) and to strengthen the capacity of the National Contact Point (NCP). The objective of the project is in line with the objective set out in point 3 of the implementing rules for the first and second rounds of project application selection under the specific support objective 1.1.1 ‘Strengthening research and innovation capacity and introducing advanced technologies into the overall research and development (R&D) system’ of the EU cohesion policy programme 2021-2027, measure 1.1.1.5 ‘Latvia’s full participation in the Horizon Europe programme, including by providing a complex range of support instruments and linking them to the development of RIS3 specialisation areas’, and the activities planned under the project are aimed at achieving this objective. The main activities planned under the project are:1.operation of the NCP, efficiency improvement and capacity building; 2. promotion of the EURAXESS portal and updating of information, including the provision of information and integration of foreign researchers into the Latvian scientific environment; 3. Representation of the interests of the Latvian Science and Innovation Community in Brussels; 4. ensuring the functioning of the contact point of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT); 5. support for the development of research project applications under Horizon Europe and the 10th Framework Programme (hereinafter referred to as the ‘Framework Programme’): 5.1. the financing of the preparation of a project not related to economic activity for associations and foundations, which are scientific institutions registered in the Register of Scientific Institutions of the Republic of Latvia (hereinafter - the Republic of Latvia), has been submitted in calls for tenders under the Horizon Europe programme and the 10th IP sub-programmes of the Programme and has been assessed above the quality threshold; 5.2. improving the quality of projects assessed above the threshold but not funded by the European Research Council (ERC) of Horizon Europe (Starting Grant, Consolidator Grant, Advanced Grant); 5.3 Advising Horizon Europe project coordinators; 6. financing of projects under the NordForsk programme; 7. ensuring project management and implementation; 8. measures to ensure communication and visual identity requirements; 9. Ensuring the participation of Latvia in the European Space Agency programmes.During the implementation of the project, the following results will be achieved: 1. Increase by 10 percentage points for Horizon Europe and programmes 10. Number of project applications submitted by Latvian participants assessed by the IP above the quality threshold; 2. the Latvian EURAXESS portal with up-to-date information will be operational; 3. The number of new (unique) foreign partners of Latvian organisations under Horizon Europe and 10 will increase by 5 percentage points. IP; 4. 4 statistical reports on Latvia's participation in the EIT have been prepared and published; 5. financing has been granted to cover project development expenses for 3 associations and foundations in the role of coordinator and 12 associations and foundations in the role of project partner; 6. 6 grants have been awarded to cover the costs of improving the ERC project application; 7. pre-screening of 24 project applications will be provided to project application coordinators; 8. funding has been granted for 6 NordForsk projects and monitoring of project implementation in Latvia has been carried out; 9. ensuring project management and project implementation; 10. measures to ensure communication and visual identity requirements; 11. Ensuring the participation of Latvia in European Space Agency (ESA) programmes. The total eligible funding for the implementation of the project is EUR 14 353 244, including EUR 12 200 257 from the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) and EUR 2152 987 from the State budget. The project agreement is planned to be concluded in April 2024 and implemented no later than 31 December 2029.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of a separate collection point for municipal waste
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Sadzīves atkritumu dalītās vākšanas punkta izveide"
Category_Label: Household waste management: prevention, minimisation, sorting, reuse, recycling measures
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Establishment of a Separate Collection Point for Municipal Waste" is to develop a separate collection system, preparation for re-use, recycling and recovery of waste from Vidzeme Waste Management Region (hereinafter referred to as SPAR). As a result of the implementation of the project, it is planned to establish a "Separate Collection Point for Municipal Waste" for the collection and temporary storage of garden and park waste and construction waste up to further operations with them, by constructing a solid surface area in Valmiera city, where the construction of two semi-submerged containers is planned, in order to create a new service not previously existing in the territory of the SPAR and Valmiera Municipality - a service for the separate collection of waste, providing a handover point for garden and park waste and construction waste.When implementing the project, successive procurements will be organised in accordance with the laws and regulations in the field of public procurement, implementing an open, transparent, non-discriminatory and non-competitive procedure for the construction and supervision of the Separate Collection Point for Municipal Waste. As a result of the procurement, contracts have been concluded with the successful tenderer in the relevant procurement and construction of one Municipal Waste Separate Collection Point in Valmiera City, author supervision and construction supervision has been implemented. During the implementation of the project, in accordance with the requirements set out in the European Union Funds 2021-2027 programming period and the Recovery Fund Communication and Design Guidelines, the ZAAO will ensure that communication and visual identity requirements are met. Also, by the date of submission of the final payment request to the liaison body, the ZAAO will implement activities in accordance with the developed ‘Plan of measures to educate the public and raise environmental awareness’, providing funding in the amount of 9.01% of the total eligible costs of the project.During the implementation of the project, as well as during the post-monitoring period, data on the impact of the project on the outcome indicators of the project will be accumulated.As a result of the implementation of the project, the amount of separately collected waste will be reached 466.00 tons per year. The total eligible costs of the project amount to EUR 549 429.00, of which the amount of Cohesion Fund financing is EUR 324 460.95, SIA ZAAO’s own co-financing is EUR 224 968.05. The planned implementation period of the project is from 2025. Quarter I until the end of 2026.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekta "Sadzīves atkritumu dalītās vākšanas punkta izveide" mērķis ir attīstīt Vidzemes atkritumu apsaimniekošanas reģiona (turpmāk VAAR) atkritumu dalītas vākšanas sistēmu, sagatavošanu atkārtotai izmantošanai, pārstrādei un reģenerācijai.Projekta ieviešanas rezultātā plānots izveidot "Sadzīves atkritumu dalītās vākšanas punktu" dārzu un parku atkritumu un būvniecības atkritumu savākšanai un īslaicīgai uzglabāšanai līdz tālākajām darbībām ar tiem, izbūvējot cietā seguma laukumu Valmieras pilsētā, kurā tiek paredzēta arī divu zemē daļēji iedziļinātukonteineru izbūve, lai radītu jaunu, līdz šim VAAR un Valmieras novada teritorijā neesošu pakalpojumu - dalīti vākto atkritumu pakalpojumu, nodrošinot dārzu un parku atkritumu un būvniecības atkritumu nodošanas punktu.Īstenojot projektu, secīgi tiks organizēti iepirkumi saskaņā ar normatīvajiem aktiem publisko iepirkumu jomā, īstenojot atklātu, pārredzamu, nediskriminējošu un konkurenci neierobežojošu procedūru par Sadzīves atkritumu dalītās vākšanas punkta būvdarbiem un būvuzraudzību. Iepirkumu rezultātā slēgti līgumi ar attiecīgā iepirkumā uzvarējušo pretendentu un īstenota viena Sadzīves atkritumu dalītās vākšanas punkta izbūve Valmieras pilsētā, autoruzraudzība un būvuzraudzība. Tāpat, līdz noslēguma maksājuma pieprasījuma iesniegšanas dienai sadarbības iestādē, ZAAO īstenos aktivitātes atbilstoši izstrādātajam “Sabiedrības izglītošanas un vides apziņas celšanas pasākumu plānam”, paredzot finansējumu 9,01% apmērā no projekta kopējām attiecināmajām izmaksām.Projekta īstenošanas laikā, kā arī pēcuzraudzības periodā tiks uzkrāti dati par projekta ietekmi uz projekta iznākuma rādītājiem.Projekta īstenošanas rezultātā tiks sasniegts šķiroti savākto atkritumu daudzums 466,00 tonnas gadā. Projekta plānotais realizācijas laiks no 2025. I ceturkšņa līdz 2026.gada beigām.

Operation_Name_English: Modernisation of the study environment of the Latvian Academy of Culture

Category_Label: ICT: Other types of ICT infrastructure (including large-scale computer resources/equipment, data centres, sensors and other wireless equipment) compliant with the carbon emission reduction and energy efficiency criteria|Infrastructure for tertiary education
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Modernization of the Studio Environment of the Latvian Academy of Culture" is to ensure the modernization of the environment of the Latvian Academy of Culture (LKA) in the buildings k-5 and k-7 of the 58a Quarter of Miera Street. The aim of the project will be achieved by implementing the following activities: 1.Reconstruction of the hulls k-7 and k-5 of Miera Street 58a, including development of design documentation, author supervision and construction supervision of the reconstructed works, reconstructed works. 2.Project management. The target group of the project is LKA students and academic staff. The modernized premises will be available to students of all LKA study programmes at all levels, therefore the results of the project are applicable to all students (in 2024 there are 742 students), as well as academic staff. The project will be implemented in the period from 1 July 2025 to 31 December 2027, achieving the following indicators: the number of users of the modernised premises per year for at least 465 students, including the capacity of the refurbished premises for at least 215 students. The planned financing of the project is EUR 1 764 707, including EUR 1 500 000 from the European Regional Development Fund and EUR 264 707 from the State budget.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekta "Latvijas Kultūras akadēmijas studija vides modernizācija" mērķis ir nodrošināt Latvijas Kultūras akadēmijas (LKA) vides modernizāciju Miera ielas 58a kvartāla ēkās k-5 un k-7. Projekta mērķis tiks sasniegts, īstenojot sekojošas darbības: 1.Miera ielas 58a korpusu k-7 un k-5 pārbūve, t.sk. projektēšanas dokumentācijas izstrāde, pārbūves darbu autoruzraudzība un būvuzraudzība, pārbūves darbi. 2.Projekta vadības nodrošināšana. Projekta mērķa grupa ir LKA studējošie un akadēmiskais personāls. Modernizētās telpas būs pieejamas visu LKA studiju programmu visos līmeņos studējošajiem, līdz ar to projekta rezultāti ir attiecināmi uz visiem studējošajiem (2024. gadā ir 742 studējošie), kā arī akadēmisko personālu. Projekts tiks īstenots laika posmā no 2025. gada 1.jūlija līdz 2027. gada 31. decembrim, sasniedzot sekojošus rādītājus: modernizēto telpu lietotāju skaits gadā vismaz 465 studējošie, t.sk. pārbūvēto telpu ietilpība – vismaz 215 studējošie. Projektā plānotais finansējums 1 764 707 euro, tai skaitā Eiropas Reģionālās attīstības fonda finansējumu – 1 500 000 euro un valsts budžeta līdzfinansējumu – 264 707 euro .

Operation_Name_English: Construction of infrastructure in Alūksne, Alūksne district, stage 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Infrastruktūras izveide Alūksnē, Alūksnes novadā, 2.kārta
Category_Label: Business infrastructure for SMEs (including industrial parks and sites)|Renewable energy: solar|Other renewable energy (including geothermal energy)
Operation_Summary_English: In order to promote the economic activity of Alūksne municipality, it is necessary to develop public infrastructure by cleaning up the existing street network, so that the municipality is attractive for the development of small and medium-sized business (including service providers) and for ensuring competitiveness, facilitating the transition to a climate-neutral economy. Due to the lack of funding, it has not been possible to improve it for several years, which significantly affects the business development potential.The project will result in the creation of the necessary public infrastructure for entrepreneurship in the city of Alūksne, making investments in the development of the street network, ensuring environmentally friendly and sustainable growth of the territory, contributing to the transition to a climate neutral economy.The main activity planned under the project is the development of public traffic infrastructure through the reconstruction of the section of Helēna Street from Jāņkalna Street to Dārza Street, Blaumaņa Street, and the section of Tirker Street.At least 1 merchant will benefit from the developed public infrastructure, at least 4 new jobs will be created, and non-financial investments in intangible investments and fixed assets of at least EUR 280 000 will be attracted.The total cost of the project is EUR 494 117.65, including JTF financing of EUR 420 000.00. Local government co-financing of the project eligible costs in the amount of 74 117.65 EUR. Outside the project costs 146 479,71 EUR, which is intended to be covered from local government budget resources.Planned total duration of the project implementation - within 15 months from the conclusion of the agreement on the project implementation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Alūksnes novada ekonomiskās aktivitātes sekmēšanai ir nepieciešams attīstīt publisko infrastruktūru, sakārtojot esošo ielu tīklu, lai novads būtu pievilcīgs mazās un vidējās uzņēmējdarbības attīstībai (tai skaitā arī pakalpojumu sniedzējiem) un konkurētspējas nodrošināšanai, veicinot pāreju uz klimatneitrālu ekonomiku.Esošajām uzņēmējdarbības attīstības teritorijām ir apgrūtināta piekļuve un pašvaldības ielu stāvoklis ir kritisks. Finansējuma trūkuma dēļ vairākus gadus to nav bijis iespējams uzlabot, kas būtiski ietekmē uzņēmējdarbības attīstības potenciālu.Projekta rezultātā tiks izveidota uzņēmējdarbībai nepieciešamā publiskā infrastruktūra Alūksnes pilsētā, veicot ieguldījumus ielu tīkla attīstībā, nodrošinot videi draudzīgu un ilgtspējīgu teritorijas izaugsmi, veicinot pāreju uz klimatneitrālu ekonomiku.Projekta ietvaros plānotā galvenā darbība ir publiskās satiksmes infrastruktūras attīstīšana veicot Helēnas ielas posma no Jāņkalna ielas līdz Dārza ielai pārbūvi, Blaumaņa ielas, un Tirgotāju ielas posma pārbūvi.No attīstītās publiskās infrastruktūras labumu gūs vismaz 1 komersants, tiks radītas vismaz 4 jaunas darba vietas, un piesaistītas nefinanšu investīcijas nemateriālajos ieguldījumos un pamatlīdzekļos vismaz 280 000 EUR apmērā.Projekta kopējās izmaksas ir 494 117,65 EUR, tajā skaitā TPF finansējums 420 000,00 EUR apmērā. Pašvaldības līdzfinansējums projekta attiecināmajām izmaksām 74 117,65 EUR apmērā.Ārpusprojekta izmaksas 146 479,71 EUR, ko paredzēts segt no pašvaldības budžeta līdzekļiem.Plānotais kopējais projekta īstenošanas ilgums - 15 mēnešu laikā no vienošanās par projekta realizāciju noslēgšanas brīža.

Operation_Name_English: Development of medical infrastructure VSIA "Traumatology and Orthopaedic Hospital"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ārstniecības infrastruktūras attīstība VSIA "Traumatoloģijas un ortopēdijas slimnīca"
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures|Health infrastructure|Health equipment
Operation_Summary_English: Within the framework of the project, VSIA "Hospital of Traumatology and Orthopaedics" plans to strengthen the health care system and ensure equal access to health care for all residents of Latvia by developing medical infrastructure in the field of spinal surgery services. The project aims to ensure equal access to healthcare and strengthen the health system by developing health infrastructure in the field of spinal surgery. Within the framework of the project, it is planned to purchase a robotic spine navigation system with complete navigable tool kits for inserting implants in an open, minimally invasive or endoscopic way, to expand one operating room in the 5th operating block of the Hospital, combining it with one of the anterooms, as well as to purchase medical equipment and equipment for spine operations. These new technologies will allow you to reduce the trauma of surgery and perform surgical manipulations in the spine with greater accuracy, significantly reduce the risk of complications and guarantee the patient's safety, perform more complex spine surgeries, including oncological surgeries, perform more accurate examinations of the spine before and after surgery, digitally plan treatment tactics, as well as reduce radiological irradiation of the patient and the doctor. In order to optimize the flow of patients in the Hospital, improve the quality of the services provided by the hospital and reduce the risk of hospital infections, it is planned to establish a new registrar for the reception of planned patients at 18 Duntes Street, redesigning the premises of the Rehabilitation Department accordingly. Taking care of patients, it is also planned to supplement the range of care items, technical aids and medical equipment. These investments in infrastructure in the priority area oncology will in particular improve the quality of healthcare for patients with oncological diseases. Within the framework of the project information and publicity measures, it is planned to promote the contribution of the European Union funds to the development of the hospital infrastructure by placing an information plaque at the project implementation site, as well as informing the public through the hospital's website and social networks. The total eligible costs of the project are EUR 3 152 533.00, including EUR 2679653.05 in ERDF funding, EUR 472 879.95 in national budget funding and private funding. The project is planned to start after the conclusion of the contract on the implementation of the project in the 2nd quarter of 2024 and to complete all activities within 24 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekta ietvaros VSIA "Traumatoloģijas un ortopēdijas slimnīca" plāno veikt veselības aprūpes sistēmas stiprināšanu un vienlīdzīgas piekļuves veselības aprūpei nodrošināšanu visiem Latvijas iedzīvotājiem, veicot ārstniecības infrastruktūras attīstību mugurkaula ķirurģijas pakalpojumu jomā. Projekta mērķis ir nodrošināt vienlīdzīgu piekļuvi veselības aprūpei un stiprināt veselības sistēmu, attīstot veselības aprūpes infrastruktūru mugurkaula ķirurģijas jomā. Projekta ietvaros ir plānots iegādāties robotizēto mugurkaula navigācijas sistēmu ar nokomplektētiem navigējamiem instrumentu komplektiem implantu ievietošanai atvērtā, minimāli invazīvā vai endoskopiskā veidā, paplašināt vienu operāciju zāli Slimnīcas 5. operāciju blokā, apvienojot to ar vienu no priekštelpām, kā arī iegādāties medicīniskās iekārtas un aprīkojumu mugurkaula operācijām. Šīs jaunās tehnoloģijas dos iespējas samazināt operācijas traumu un ar lielāku precizitāti veikt ķirurģiskās manipulācijas mugurkaulā, ievērojami samazināt komplikāciju risku un garantēt pacienta drošību, veikt sarežģītākas mugurkaula operācijas, t.sk. onkoloģiskas operācijas, veikt precīzāku izmeklēšanu mugurkaulam pirms un pēc operācijas, digitāli plānot ārstēšanas taktiku, kā arī samazināt radioloģisko apstarojumu pacientam un ārstam. Lai optimizētu pacientu plūsmu Slimnīcā,uzlabotu stacionāra sniegto pakalpojumu kvalitāti un mazinātu hospitālās infekcijas izpaltīšanās riskus, ir plānots izveidot jaunu reģistratūru plānveida pacientu uzņemšanai Duntes ielā 18, attiecīgi pārveidojot Rehabilitācijas nodaļas telpas. Rūpējoties par pacientu aprūpi, ir plānots arī papildināt aprūpes priekšmetu, tehnisko palīglīdzekļu un medicīnas tehnikas klāstu. Šie ieguldījumi infrastruktūrā onkoloģijas prioritārajā jomā īpaši uzlabos veselības aprūpes kvalitāti pacientiem ar onkoloģiskajām slimībām. Projekta informācijas un publicitātes pasākumu ietvaros ir plānots popularizēt Eiropas Savienības fondu ieguldījumu slimnīcas infrastruktūras attīstībā, izvietojot informācijas plāksni projekta īstenošanas vietā, kā arī informējot sabiedrību ar slimnīcas mājas lapas un sociālo tīklu palīdzību. Projekta kopējās attiecināmās izmaksas 3 152 533,00 EUR, tai skaitā 2679653,05 EUR ERAF finansējums, 472 879,95 EUR valsts budžeta finansējums un privātais finansējums. Projektu plānots uzsākt pēc līguma noslēgšanas par projekta īstenošanu 2024.gada 2.ceturksnī un pabeigt visas darbības 24 mēnešu laikā.

Operation_Name_English: Flood risk reduction measures in Ventspils city
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Plūdu riska samazināšanas pasākumi Ventspils valstspilsētā
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide the residents of Ventspils city municipality with a quality living environment, increase the competitiveness and continued existence of economic activity by adapting to climate change, reconstructing the city's rainwater drainage infrastructure. It provides for the reconstruction of the surface run-off and rainwater drainage infrastructure by restoring the rainwater sewer collectors at Inženieru Street in the section from Katoļu Street to Kuldīga Street and at Jūras Street in the section from Brīvības Street to Ganību Street, Ventspils. As a result of the implementation of the project, 16 464 residents will benefit in Ventspils. The project is planned to start in the 1st quarter of 2025, but the works will be completed in the 1st quarter of 2026. The total cost of the project is estimated at EUR 1 968 000. Operation_Name_English: Development of infrastructure for patient reception facilities and outpatient offices of SIA Jūrmala Hospital
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SIA “Jūrmalas slimnīca” pacientu uzņemšanas telpu un ambulatoro kabinetu infrastruktūras attīstība
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures|Health infrastructure|Health equipment
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to ensure equal access to health care and strengthen the health system by developing the infrastructure for health services in the patient reception facilities and outpatient offices of SIA Jurmalas Hospital. The target group of the project is the inhabitants of Latvia, most often the inhabitants of the city of Jūrmala and its nearest municipalities (Mārupes, Tukums, etc.), who need to ensure access to health care services. In accordance with Cabinet Regulation No 555 of 28 August 2018 on the organisation and payment of health care, the project applicant, SIA Jurmalas Hospital, is a level III hospital which must operate in six mandatory profiles (therapy, care for chronic patients, surgery, gynaecology, pregnancy and childbirth profile, paediatrics) and provide emergency medical assistance. The project provides for the development of a construction project for the reconstruction of reception rooms and outpatient cabinets, after which the construction works, the development of a project and the construction works are expected to involve environmental and information accessibility experts. Within the framework of the implementation of the project, the purchase of medical devices for the provision of reception facilities and outpatient cabinets is also planned. The activities envisaged in the project are directly aimed at filling existing gaps and gaps in the current situation in the work of SIA Jurmalas Hospital (hereinafter – Hospital) in the reception of patients and in outpatient offices: As a result of the reconstruction of the reception facilities and the expansion of the premises, functional, hygienic and modern universal design, as well as working rooms that meet the requirements of environmental accessibility, will be provided for rapid, high-quality assessment of the patient's state of health and provision of assistance.Installation of automatic exterior doors will ensure independent access of all patients to the reception facilities without additional assistance and assistance. Removing the front desk and creating a counter of different levels will ensure the accessibility of the environment, including for employees with special needs and visitors in wheelchairs. The waiting time for acute, urgent patients in reception will be reduced, as expanding the premises and improving the infrastructure will make it easier and faster to provide examinations for multiple patients at the same time. The number of outpatient services will increase, which will lead to an increase in the availability of these services for Hospital patients and an increase in the number of outpatient services provided. The main achievements of the improved infrastructure in reception facilities and outpatient offices during the implementation of the project can be noted : • Access to health care services in reception and in the outpatient part of the population living in the hospital service area will be improved, including for those at risk of social, territorial exclusion and poverty. • Every hospital patient will receive the necessary treatment for their needs in a timely manner in premises equipped with the appropriate technological equipment and of the appropriate quality, which at the same time would contribute to the economic benefits for the patient in terms of treatment in the future (reduction in the number of admitted, undiagnosed diseases in a timely manner). The total eligible costs of the project are EUR 1 196 771, including European Regional Development Fund financing of EUR 1017255.30, state budget financing of EUR 61312.72, private financing of EUR 118202.98. The project is planned to be implemented from January 2025 to August 2027. Before entering into a contract with the Central Finance Agreement Agency, it is planned to start the procurement for the development of the construction design and to enter into a contract for the services of an environmental accessibility specialist.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekta mērķis ir nodrošināt vienlīdzīgu piekļuvi veselības aprūpei un stiprināt veselības sistēmu, attīstot veselības aprūpes pakalpojumu infrastruktūru SIA “Jūrmalas slimnīca” pacientu uzņemšanas telpās un ambulatorajos kabinetos. Projekta mērķa grupa ir Latvijas iedzīvotāji, visbiežāk – Jūrmalas pilsētas un tai tuvāko novadu (Mārupes, Tukuma , u.c.) iedzīvotāji, kuriem ir nepieciešams nodrošināt veselības aprūpes pakalpojumu pieejamību. Projekta iesniedzējs – SIA “Jūrmalas slimnīca” atbilstoši Ministru kabineta 28.08.2018. noteikumiem nr.555 “Veselības aprūpes organizēšanas un samaksas kārtība” ir III līmeņa slimnīca, kurai jānodrošina darbība sešos obligātajos profilos (terapija, hronisku pacientu aprūpe, ķirurģija, ginekoloģija, grūtniecības un dzemdību profils, pediatrija), kā arī jāsniedz neatliekamā medicīniskā palīdzība. Projektā paredzēts veikt būvprojekta izstrādi uzņemšanas telpu un ambulatoro kabinetu pārbūvei, pēc tam būvdarbus, proejkta izstrādei un būvdarbiem paredzēts piesaistīt vides un informācijas piekļūstamības ekspertus. Projekta īstenošanas ietvaros paredzēta arī medicīnas ierīču iegāde uzņemšanas telpu un ambulatoro kabinetu darbības nodrošināšanai. Projektā paredzamās darbības ir tieši vērstas uz pastāvošo trūkumu un nepilnību novēršanu šā brīža situācijā SIA “Jūrmalas slimnīca” (turpmāk -Slimnīca) darbā pacientu uzņemšanā un ambulatorajos kabinetos: Uzņemšanas telpu pārbūves un telpu paplašināšanas rezultātā tiks nodrošinātas funkcionālas, higiēnas un mūsdienu universālā dizaina, kā arī vides pieejamības prasībām atbilstošas darba telpas, ātrai, kvalitatīvai pacienta veselības stāvokļa novērtēšanai un palīdzības sniegšanai.Automātisko ārdurvju uzstādīšana nodrošinās patstāvīgu neatkarīgu visu pacientu iekļūšanu uzņemšanas telpās bez papildus palīdzības un asistēšanas. Reģistratūras pārvietošana un dažādu līmeņu letes izveide, nodrošinās vides pieejamību, t.sk. darbiniekiem ar īpašām vajadzībām un apmeklētājiem ratiņkrēslos. Samazināsies akūto, neatliekamo pacientu gaidīšanas laiks uzņemšanā, jo paplašinoties telpām un uzlabojoties infrastruktūrai būs vienkāršāk un ātrāk nodrošināt vairāku pacientu apskates vienlaicīgi. Palielināsies ambulatoro pakalpojumu sniegšanas telpu skaits, kā rezultātā palielināsies pieejamība šiem pakalpojumiem Slimnīcas pacientiem un palielināsies sniegto ambulatoro pakalpojumu skaits. Kā galvenos projekta īstenošanas gaitā pilnveidotās infrastruktūras uzņemšanas telpās un ambulatorajos kabinetos sasniegumus var atzīmēt : • Tiks uzlabota Slimnīcas apkalpes zonā dzīvojošo iedzīvotāju veselības aprūpes pakalpojumu pieejamība pakalpojumiem uzņemšanā un ambulatorajā daļā, tai skaitā arī sociālās, teritoriālās atstumtības un nabadzības riskam pakļautajiem iedzīvotājiem. • Ikviens Slimnīcas pacients saņems savām vajadzībām nepieciešamo ārstēšanu savlaicīgi ar atbilstošu tehnoloģisko nodrošinājumu aprīkotās telpās un atbilstošā kvalitātē, kas vienlaikus sekmētu ekonomiskos ieguvumus attiecībā pacientu uz ārstēšanu nākotnē (samazinās ielaistu, savlaicīgi nediagnosticētu saslimšanu skaits). Projekta kopējās attiecināmās izmaksas ir EUR 1 196 771, tai skaitā Eiropas reģionālā attīstības fonda finansējums EUR 1017255.30, valsts budžeta finansējums EUR 61312.72, privātais finansējums EUR 118202.98. Projektu plānots realizēt no 2025.gada janvāra līdz 2027.gada augustam. Pirms līguma ar Centrālo finanšu līgumu aģentūru noslēgšanas plānots uzsākt iepirkumu būvprojekta izstrādei un noslēgt līgumu par vides pieejamības speciālista pakalpojumiem.

Operation_Name_English: Technology to maintain biodiversity in traditionally managed hemiboreal forests
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Tehnoloģija bioloģiskās daudzveidības uzturēšanai tradicionāli apsaimniekotos hemiboreālos mežos
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and higher education sector|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: Northern Europe is a region capable of providing locally produced raw materials for the development of the European Union's bioeconomy, even in the face of rapid climate change. Due to the growing demand for wood resources and the strategies to balance different management objectives at forest landscape level, traditional forest management is expected to continue to prevail in the region. It is therefore essential to ensure that measures to conserve and promote biological diversity in agricultural forests are effective. The objective of the project is therefore to assess the effectiveness of the evaluative measures and to develop the technology to improve them in terms of promoting biodiversity, in order to ensure the implementation of a wider range of close-to-nature forestry measures in the European Hemiboreal Forests (in the eastern part of the Baltic region).The project will be carried out as a practical, non-economic industrial research in the field of smart specialisation (RIS3) in the knowledge-intensive bioeconomy, agriculture, forestry and fisheries. The results will contribute to the development of the economic sector of forestry and other forestry activities (NACE 2 02.10). The project will be implemented in cooperation with forest management companies, based on the competence of their staff: 1) INGKA Investments Management Ltd., the largest private forest owner in the Baltic States (providing detailed information and competence in the project for the selection of research objects and possibilities for effective data collection). The objective of the company is to ensure sustainable forestry and a strategy to implement forestry components closer to Cuba, thus there is a high interest in encouraging the development of appropriate recommendations and policies; 2) OTEMA Ltd. has high personnel qualifications and competences in assessing the diversity of epiphytes and subterranean species. The companyrepresentsssmall forestowners, soitsinvolvementis essential to check the scalability of project results, which are essential for the economy and the development of RIS3 in rural areas.The project will be led by the lead researcher Dr.biol. Robert Matison has considerable experience in assessing the biodiversity of the forest ecosystem, managing projects and developing scientific publications. This will ensure progress for young researchers, involving a young researcher and twodoctoral players.The main project challenges are:1) Effectiveness: assess the short- and medium-term impact of the species, number and distribution of ecological trees (scattered, small, large groups) on medium- and large-bird breeding success and on the diversity of other species groups;2) Ecological capacity: Quantitative characterisation of the sufficiency of ecological trees for nesting birds in intensively managed forests, comparing those where harvesting is not allowed or widely used.3) Disturbance: Assess the impact of post-regeneration felling management measures (e.g. soil preparation, planting, agro-technical and young stand management) on the success of the rearing of medium and large birds in ecological trees and other species groups;4) Recolonisation: Assess the impact of ecological tree species, distribution and forest type on encouraging the recolonisation of epiphytes in young stands in the medium term;5)Area of openings: Assess the long-term effects of the harvesting scale on ground vegetation and epiphytes, taking into account the variability in the area of openings in the context of the occurrence of species of birds with light-required epiphytes and openings.Each of the tasks will be concluded with at least one open scientific publication and presentation of the conference. In addition, the results will be disseminated through forest sector workshops and events (at least 4) and presented to policymakers in the ministries dealing with the protection and management of the forest ecosystem (Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Smart Administration and Regional Development, Ministry of Climate and Energy). The research partner (LVMI Silava), in an open auction, will provide a licence agreement for the technology to increase the efficiency of the use of biodiversity protection elements to meet their target to develop it as anintegrated tool in the forest management support systems, thus developing it at a higher technology readiness level.The total budget of the project will be €592218,59 (ERDF funding €459983,96), will be implemented within 36 months.The project will start in October 2025, while the mid-term month will be March 2027.The implementation period of the project will be from 01.10.2025 to 30.09.2028.No activities will take place before the signature of the implementation agreement.Key words: ecological forestry, forest management, biodiversity components, bird species groups, epiphytes, highly developed forestry.

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to modernise the learning environment of the art education competence centre "Latgale Music and Art Secondary School" (hereinafter - MIKC LMMV) for the acquisition of skills relevant to the sectors.The target group of the project is the professional education institution MIKC LMMV founded by the state, teachers and students of this school. The total number of students in secondary vocational and vocational education in the academic year 2023/2024 is 667 students and 117 educators, totalling 784 persons. MIKC LMMV operates as a regional methodological centre, which provides further education activities for teachers of the cultural education sector. Thus, the indirect target group is an additional 85 teachers of the region.The main activities of the project are the development of construction projects for three objects, technical project expertise, reconstruction works, construction supervision, author supervision and environmental accessibility audit for three MIKC LMMV school buildings - the Service Hotel at 9 Raina Street, the Rezekne Art and Design School structural unit training building at 34A Baznicas Street and the Jānis Ivanovs Music School structural unit training building at 56 Liberation Alley, as well as the modernisation of the educational material base of the educational institution for the acquisition of skills relevant to economic sectors. The project will significantly improve the quality of the learning environment in the field of cultural education in Latgale region and is part of joint, mutually consistent and complementary investment activities implemented by the leading ministries of the sector. The project also provides for publicity, management and implementation activities. Within the framework of the project, it is planned to supply modern equipment and equipment for the acquisition of current skills in the field of cultural education: Apple's latest-generation processor computers for the development of digital art and design objects, software management machines and 3D machines for the production of digital works, as well as specific equipment for improving material processing skills. All equipment is intended to be purchased and installed so that it can be used by all students of educational programs for the development of formwork, spatial art and design works, for the development of their course and diploma works. The total cost of the project is EUR 3 000 000, of which the amount of support from the European Regional Development Fund is EUR 2 550 000. Project implementation time from the date of signing the contract in the 1st quarter of 2025 until 31 December 2029. The project ensures compliance with the principles of equality, non-discrimination, climate security and energy efficiency, as well as do no significant harm.

Kopējais izglītojamo skaits vidējā profesionālajā un profesionālās ievirzes izglītībā 2023./2024. mācību gadā ir 667 izglītojamie un 117 pedagogi, kopā tas sastāda 784 personas. MIKC LMMV darbojas kā reģiona metodiskais centrs, kurš nodrošina tālākizglītības pasākumus kultūrizglītības nozares pedagogiem. Līdz ar to netiešā mērķa grupa ir vēl papildus 85 reģiona pedagogi.Galvenās projekta darbības ir būvprojektu izstrāde trim objektiem, tehnisko projektu ekspertīze, pārbūves darbi, būvuzraudzība, autoruzraudzība un vides pieejamības audits trim MIKC LMMV skolas ēkām - Dienesta viesnīcai Raiņa ielā 9, Rēzeknes Mākslas un dizaina skolas struktūrvienības mācību ēkai Baznīcas ielā 34A un Jāņa Ivanova Mūzikas skolas struktūrvienības mācību ēkai Atbrīvošanas alejā 56, kā arī izglītības iestādes mācību materiālās bāzes modernizēšana tautsaimniecības nozarēm aktuālo prasmju apguvei. Projekts būtiski uzlabos mācību vides kvalitāti kultūrizglītības jomā Latgales reģionā un ir daļa no kopīgu, savstarpēji saskanīgu un papildinošu investīciju darbībām, ko īsteno nozares vadošās ministrijas. Projekta ietvaros paredzētas mūsdienīgu iekārtu un aprīkojuma piegādes kultūrizglītības nozares aktuālo prasmju apguvei: Apple ražotāja jaunākās paaudzes procesoru datori digitālo mākslas un dizaina priekšmetu attīstībai, programvadības darbagaldi un 3D iekārtas digitālo darbu izgatavošanai, kā arī specifiskās iekārtas materiālu apstrādes prasmju uzlabošanai. Visas iekārtas paredzētas iegādāties un uzstādīt, lai tās varētu izmantot visus izglītības programmu izglītojamie formveides, telpisku mākslas un dizaina darbu attīstībai, savu kursa un diplomdarbu kvalitatīvākai izstrādei. Kopējās projekta izmaksas ir 3 000 000 euro, tai skaitā Eiropas Reģionālās attīstības fonda atbalsta apjoms ir 2 550 000 euro. Projekta īstenošanas laiks no līguma parakstīšanas dienas 2025.gada I ceturksnī līdz 2029.gada 31.decembrim. Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Childcare service" is to provide support to local governments for the purchase of a child supervision service, promoting work-life balance and equal opportunities for all families. The target group of the measure is families raising pre-school age children (from the age of one and a half years until the commencement of basic education) and for which local governments, in the administrative territory of which the place of residence of such children and at least one of the parents (legal representative) of such child is declared, do not provide places in pre-school educational institutions of local governments, including groups of socially and economically vulnerable persons. When implementing the project, the co-financing of the municipality will be reduced, parents will not have to cover the co-financing share, directly improving the socio-economic situation of families with children of pre-school age. By providing childcare services, it is possible to raise the standard of living of the population, as parents of children of preschool age can return to the labour market in a timely manner. The implementation of the decision during the implementation of the project has a significant impact on the au pair sector, providing au pairs with children, the project has an impact on all sectors of the economy during its operation, providing the possibility for parents to resume work in a timely manner. As of 1 October 2023, there are 213 children aged 1.5 and over to the place in the municipal pre-school educational institution. Within the framework of the project, the planned result of the project is at least 150 children and their parents or legal representatives who have received a child supervision service for at least one to three years. The planned amount of European Social Fund Plus (hereinafter - ESF+) support is 364 eur (85% of the funding) and local government co-financing 64.24 eur (15% of the funding) per child in one calendar month, totalling 428.24 eur of funding. By providing a child supervision service for 150 children in one calendar year, the total cost of the project reaches 822 220, 80 eur and in the three-year period 2 312 496, 00 eur, of which 1 965 600,00 eur is ESF+ funding and 346 896,00 eur is municipal co-financing. Project costs in each year are calculated after the project service provision period (number of calendar months in the particular year of project implementation). The project is planned to be implemented as of September 2024, which means that in 2024 the total cost for the 4-month period is 256 944, 00 eur of which 218 400, 00 is ESF+ funding and 38 544, 00 eur is municipal co-financing. In 2025 and 2026, the project costs for one calendar year amount to 770 832.00 eur, of which 655 200.00 eur is ESF+ funding and 115 632.00 eur is municipal co-financing. In 2027, for the 8-month period of the project, the costs amount to 513 888, 00 eur of which 436 800, 00 eur is ESF+ funding and 77 088, 00 eur is municipal co-financing. Within the framework of the project, in September 2024, it is planned to request the payment of an advance of 30%, which is the maximum amount available within the framework of the project. The project is planned to be implemented from September 2024 (3rd quarter) and the project is planned to be implemented for 3 years until the end of August 2027 (3rd quarter).

Īstenojot projektu, tiks samazināts pašvaldības līdzfinansējums, vecākiem nebūs jāsedz līdzfinansējuma daļa, tiešā veidā uzlabojot sociālekonomisko situāciju ģimenēm ar bērniem pirmsskolas vecumā. Nodrošinot bērnu pieskatīšanas pakalpojumu, ir iespējams paaugstināt iedzīvotāju dzīves līmeni, jo pirmsskolas vecumā bērnu vecāki var laicīgi atgriezties darba tirgū. Operation_Name_English: Solar blind UV-C photodetectors from thin films of amorphous ultra-wide area semiconductors (GoFarUV)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Saules akli UV-C fotodetektori no amorfu ultraplatzonas pusvadītāju plānām kārtiņām (GoFarUV)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and higher education sector|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of this industrial research project is to develop a new photodetector based on a thin film of amorphous aluminium gallium oxide (AlGaO) semiconductor solid solution produced by scalable high application rate magnetrono blasting (GoFarUV) of high UV blinds. We offer to develop and research a new AlGaO semiconductor material, and optimize its synthesis parameters to obtain photoelectric properties suitable for high UV light detection. The applications of such solar blind UV-C photodetectors include environmental monitoring and space exploration, both of which are essential to address global climate challenges. Detectors will allow for more accurate monitoring of atmospheric changes, such as ozone formation, and early detection of forest fires, providing critical data to mitigate the effects of climate change. Other applications include space science and technology, security and military. The project will be implemented by the Institute of Solid State Physics of the University of Latvia (LU CFI, leading partner, project scientific manager Dr. Edgars Butanovs), planned film coating company AGL Technologies (SME, partner No. 1), and microelectronics manufacturer and developer RD ALFA Microelectronics (SME, partner No. 2). This interdisciplinary project consists of research activities in physics (1.3) and chemistry (1.4), electrical engineering, electronics, information and communication technologies (2.2) and material sciences (2.5). Project results: • New reactive dc magnetron dusting process for the application of amorphous AlGaO thin films on solid and bendable substrates for use in UV-C photosensors (patent application); • New knowledge of the physical phenomena that determine the relationship between the parameters of the dusting process and the optical and photoelectric properties of the films, necessary for optimising the photoelectric performance of AlGaO films (scientific publications); • Innovative packaging solutions for integrating developed semiconductor chips suitable for UV-C detection up to 200 nm wavelength, including backlight capability (prototype demonstration). Our proposed methodology brings significant innovations in this field, using a relatively green, high application rate semiconductor extraction technique for solar blind photodetector with maximum sensitivity further in the UV-C range. The implementation of the project will significantly increase Latvia's innovation capacity by developing modern photodetectors based on thin films of the amorphous AlGaO. This technology will open up new market opportunities and strengthen the competitiveness of Latvian companies in such knowledge-intensive industries as space technologies, environmental monitoring and optoelectronics. GoFarUV's goal supports the emergence of high-quality products and services, increasing energy efficiency and improving Latvia's knowledge base and human capital. By promoting cooperation between the research institute and two private companies, the project will support the growth of research and development capacities and increase Latvia's opportunities to export innovative technologies. GoFarUV is closely linked to the RIS3 specialisation ‘Photonics and smart materials, technologies and engineering systems’ and supports those sectors of future growth (directions 1, 2 and 3) where high value-added products and services exist or are likely to emerge. This will contribute to the development of innovation in a number of RIS3 sectors, including C.26 and C.27 (NACE classification). The project is not related to economic activity and combines fundamental and industrial research. The research team will consist of experienced and young researchers, STEM students and industry experts. The total eligible costs are EUR 651 600 with an ERDF contribution of EUR 505 962.50. The duration of the project is 36 months (01.06.2025 – 31.05.2028). Mid-term of the project: 18 months after the start of the project. Keywords: thin films, magnetron dusting, gallium oxide, amorphous semiconductor, ultraviolet, photodetector, roll method.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Šī rūpnieciskā pētījuma projekta mērķis ir izstrādāt jaunu saules aklu tālās UV gaismas fotodetektoru, kura pamatā ir amorfa alumīnija gallija oksīda (AlGaO) pusvadītāju cietā šķīduma plānā kārtiņa, kas iegūta, izmantojot mērogojamu augsta uzklāšanas ātruma magnetrono izputināšanu (GoFarUV). Mēs piedāvājam izstrādāt un pētīt jaunu AlGaO pusvadītāju materiālu, un optimizēt tā sintēzes parametrus, lai iegūtu fotoelektriskās īpašības, kas piemērotas tālās UV gaismas detektēšanai. Šādu saules aklu UV-C fotodetektoru pielietojumi ietver vides monitoringu un kosmosa izpēti, kas abi ir būtiski, lai risinātu globālās klimata problēmas. Detektori ļaus precīzāk novērot atmosfēras izmaiņas, piemēram, ozona veidošanos, un veikt savlaicīgu mežu ugunsgrēku atklāšanu, nodrošinot kritiskus datus klimata pārmaiņu ietekmes mazināšanai. Citi pielietojumi ietver kosmosa zinātni un tehnoloģijas, drošību un militāro jomu. Projektu īstenos Latvijas Universitātes Cietvielu fizikas institūts (LU CFI, vadošais partneris, projekta zinātniskais vadītājs Dr. Edgars Butanovs), plāno kārtiņu pārklājumu uzņēmums AGL Technologies (MVU, partneris Nr. 1), un mikroelektronikas ražotājs un izstrādātājs RD ALFA Microelectronics (MVU, partneris Nr. 2). Šis starpdisciplinārais projekts sastāv no pētniecības aktivitātēm fizikas (1.3.) un ķīmijas (1.4.) zinātnēs, elektrotehnikā, elektronikā, informācijas un komunikācijas tehnoloģijās (2.2.) un materiālzinātnēs (2.5.). Projekta rezultāti: • Jauns reaktīvs līdzstrāvas magnetronās izputināšanas process amorfu AlGaO plānu kārtiņu uzklāšanai uz cietām un lokāmām pamatnēm izmantošanai UV-C fotosensoros (patenta pieteikums); • Jaunas zināšanas par fizikālajām parādībām, kas nosaka izputināšanas procesa parametru saistību ar kārtiņu optiskajām un fotoelektriskajām īpašībām, un kuras nepieciešamas, lai optimizētu AlGaO kārtiņu fotoelektrisko veiktspēju (zinātniskas publikācijas); • Inovatīvi iepakošanas risinājumi izstrādāto pusvadītāju mikroshēmu integrēšanai, kas piemēroti UV-C detektēšanai līdz 200 nm viļņa garumam, tajā skaitā ar aizmugures apgaismošanas iespēju (prototipa demonstrācija). Mūsu piedāvātā metodika ienes ievērojamus jauninājumus šajā jomā, izmantojot salīdzinoši zaļu, augsta uzklāšanas ātruma pusvadītāju iegūšanas paņēmienu saules akliem fotodetektoriem ar maksimālo jutību tālāk UV-C diapazonā. Projekta īstenošana būtiski paaugstinās Latvijas inovāciju kapacitāti, izstrādājot modernus fotodetektorus, kuru pamatā ir amorfas AlGaO plānas kārtiņas. Šī tehnoloģija pavērs jaunas tirgus iespējas un stiprinās Latvijas uzņēmumu konkurētspēju tādās zinātņietilpīgās nozarēs kā kosmosa tehnoloģijas, vides monitorings un optoelektronika. GoFarUV mērķi atbalsta augstvērtīgu produktu un pakalpojumu rašanos, paaugstinot energoefektivitāti un pilnveidojot Latvijas zināšanu bāzi un cilvēkkapitālu. Veicinot sadarbību starp pētniecības institūtu un diviem privātiem uzņēmumiem, projekts atbalstīs pētniecības un attīstības spēju izaugsmi, un palielinās Latvijas iespējas eksportēt inovatīvas tehnoloģijas. GoFarUV ir cieši saistīts ar RIS3 specializācijas jomu “Fotonika un viedie materiāli, tehnoloģijas un inženiersistēmas” un atbalsta tās nākotnes izaugsmes nozares (1., 2. un 3. virziens), kurās pastāv vai varētu parādīties produkti un pakalpojumi ar augstu pievienoto vērtību. Tas veicinās inovāciju attīstību vairākās RIS3 nozarēs, tajā skaitā, C.26 un C.27 (NACE klasifikācija). Projekts nav saistīts ar saimniecisko darbību, un apvieno fundamentālos un rūpnieciskos pētījumus. Pētnieku komandu veidos pieredzējušie un jaunie pētnieki, STEM studenti un industrijas eksperti. Kopējās attiecināmās izmaksas ir 651 600 EUR ar ERAF ieguldījumu 505 962.50 EUR. Projekta ilgums ir 36 mēneši (01.06.2025 – 31.05.2028). Projekta vidusposms: 18 mēneši pēc projekta sākuma. Atslēgas vārdi: plānas kārtiņas, magnetronā izputināšana, gallija oksīds, amorfs pusvadītājs, ultraviolets, fotodetektors, ruļļu metode.

Operation_Summary_English: Title of the project: Strengthening societal resilience and promoting community self-organisationThe aim of the project is to strengthen the capacity of local communities to self-organise, cooperate and participate in creating an understanding of the common good, promoting a sense of responsibility for peers and the development of societal resilience skills, while using the potential of regional NGO support centres and strengthening the effective and sustainable functioning of civil society.The project will provide support to the target groups of the project - the active population of the community, informal initiative groups, associations and foundations, regional NGO support centres, vulnerable or at risk of social exclusion. Key project activities:• Development and implementation of a methodological programme of practical civil society initiatives to strengthen the resilience of local communities;• Development of criteria and selection and implementation of community initiatives in municipalities, promoting community cohesion and resilience skills;• Development of support networks for the activation of different communities, including cooperation platforms (creation of social network groups);• Implementation of cohesive, cooperation and experience-sharing activities for regional NGO support centres, community non-governmental organisations and activists;• Implementation of publicity activities to inform the public about the progress and results of the project, including a communication campaign;• Analysis of the impact of the project and development of recommendations for further support to civil society. Achievable monitoring indicators: · Output indicator – number of national, regional or local public administrations or public service bodies and services supported – 5, including by 31 December 2024 – 5; · Output indicator - Number of non-governmental organisations and community representatives with strengthened capacity to contribute to societal resilience - 60"Planned additional results:• Strengthened indicatively 300 citizen resilience, self-organisation, participation and collaboration skills;• Supported at least 80 community initiatives focused on strengthening community resilience capacities and developing self-organisation, cooperation and participation skills; • 1 civil society support network activity in Latvia for the activation, consolidation and promotion of resilience skills of local communities, including social networking groups;• at least 10 events (nine national and one international) have taken place with the aim of communicating the project results and good practices, as well as promoting cross-sectoral cooperation and citizens' cohesion;• a public awareness campaign has been implemented, on the initiatives implemented with the aim of encouraging public interest and active involvement in civic activities. Project funding: EUR 3 663 679 (of which financing from the European Union Fund Plus (hereinafter - ESF+): 3 114 127 EUR, co-financing from the state budget: 549 552 EUR) The project will be implemented by five partners: Association "Latvian Civic Alliance" is a beneficiary (lead partner) who will implement the project in cooperation with association "Zemgales NGO Centre", association "South Latgale NGO Support Centre", association "Kurzeme NGO Centre", foundation "Valmiera Municipality Foundation". Project implementation period: the planned date of conclusion of the contract on the implementation of the project, provisionally April 2025, shall be considered as the beginning of the implementation of the project. Implementation of project activities has started from 13 December 2024, starting to implement project activity No.10 "Ensuring project management and implementation"

Operation_Name_English: Development of a complex microbial society cultivation system based on the principles of microbial ecology
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mikroorganismu ekoloģijas principos balstīta sarežģītu mikrobiālo sabiedrību kultivācijas sistēmas izstrādne
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and higher education sector|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The principles of microbial ecology derived from observational research on natural microbial communities can help develop technical solutions to sustain complex microbial communities with high potential for in vitro industrial applications. However, the implementation of the principles of microbial ecology in research and development is hampered by the lack of accessible, user-friendly technologies and bioreactor systems with the corresponding functions of small workloads, multiple parallel cultivation volumes, with controlled mass transfer between them. In order to solve this problem, we have set the following project goal: develop accessible technical solutions (technology and bioreactor prototype) that would allow the application of the principles of microbial ecology for the cultivation, monitoring and enrichment of limited complex microbial communities in the bioreactor system. The objective of the project will be achieved through cooperation between three partners: University of Latvia (lead, research organisation), SIA Biosan (company producing biotechnology and laboratory equipment, economic operator), SIA Metabonet (company providing metabolomics service, economic operator). The tasks of the project will be based on an interdisciplinary approach, which includes microbial biotechnology, metabolomics, metagenomics, biotechnological equipment design, engineering, electronics and programming. Actions: Activity 1: innovative microbial ecology-based technology for the cultivation and monitoring of a limited number of complex microbial communities. Activity 2: Small-scale, multi-volume bioreactor prototype adapted to maintain complex microbial communities Activity 3: Innovative technology and bioreactor prototype validation Activity 4: Project coordination, support, dissemination of results and public communication Results: Three open access Q1 scientific publications Two big data sets stored in public data repositories, ensuring data sustainability and following the FAIR principles. Bioreactor prototype , which combines several parallel cultivation volumes, a small working volume with functions that allow the controlled transfer of mass between cultivation volumes. Knowledge-how on how to implement microbial ecology-based principles in the design of small-scale bioreactors Employment of early-career researcher – 1 new researcher post employing Master's degree Private investment volume R&D 33'848 EUR Public science measure (HP VINPI indicator support) Non-discriminatory approach - Project management and implementation teams have 55+ persons and a balanced representation of men/women (HP VINPI indicator support). Impact on RIS3 objectives and indicators The project results will have a direct impact on two areas of RIS3 specialisation: Biomedicine, medical technologies, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology Photonics and smart materials, technologies and engineering systems Knowledge on how to use meta-society theory-based principles for the cultivation of microorganisms in a bioreactor system has significant potential to be used in the development of innovative high added-value products in biotechnology, one of the key technologies defined by the European Commission. The development of an innovative bioreactor prototype will allow creating a new market niche for electronic laboratory equipment, contributing to the growth priority of Priority 7 "Developed knowledge base and human capital in basic technologies" of the RIS3 Smart Strategy. The project will directly contribute to the achievement of the RIS3 strategic objectives with the following RIS3 micro-level indicator figures: number of business partners (2), number of publications (1), number of joint publications with the industrial partner (2), number of technologies developed with commercialisation potential after the project implementation period (1), P&D staff – early career researcher (1), doctoral candidate (1), doctoral student (1), master student (1), private investment in research and development (EUR 33'849). Project type: Industrial research, fundamental research (<20% of total eligible costs) and experimental development (<20% of total eligible costs). Principal investigator: Jānis Liepiņš (PhD, asoc. prof.) Project duration: until 31.08.2028 (36 months) Project start: 1 September 2025 Mid-term report: 28.02.2027 (in the 18th month of the project) Financing: 656000.00 EUR (incl. ERDF funding 509712.00 EUR) Keywords: microbial communities, microbial ecology, bioreactor, metabolomics, bioremediation
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Mikroorganismu ekoloģijas principi, kas izriet no dabisko mikrobu kopienu novērošanas pētījumiem, var palīdzēt izstrādāt tehniskus risinājumus, lai uzturētu sarežģītas mikrobu kopienas ar augstu potenciālu rūpnieciskiem lietojumiem in vitro. Tomēr mikroorganismu ekoloģijas principu ieviešanu pētniecībā un izstrādē kavē pieejamu, lietotājam draudzīgu tehnoloģiju un bioreaktoru sistēmu trūkums ar attiecīgām funkcijām – nelieliem darba apjomiem, vairāku paralēlu kultivācijas tilpumu, ar kontrolētu masas pārnesi starp tiem. Lai atrisinātu šo problēmu, esam izvirzījuši sekojošu Projekta mērķi: izstrādāt pieejamus tehniskos risinājumus (tehnoloģiju un bioreaktora prototipu), kas ļautu pielietot mikrobu ekoloģijas principus ierobežota apjoma kompleksu mikrobu kopienu kultivēšanai, monitoringam un bagātināšanai bioreaktoru sistēmā. Projekta mērķis tiks sasniegts, sadarbojoties trim partneriem – Latvijas Universitātei (vadošais, pētniecības organizācija), SIA Biosan (uzņēmums, kas ražo biotehnoloģijas un laboratorijas iekārtas, saimnieciskās darbības veicējs), SIA Metabonet (uzņēmums, kas sniedz metabolomikas pakalpojumu, saimnieciskās darbības veicējs).
